title: A failed fit and a rescaled endpoint have precise limits
statement: Early heat searches failed at several small parameters but did not refute original target,the method or all r<1. Later numerical proposals r=.73,.75,.8,.9 have near-one coefficients/positive reduced-face margins,some solver-inaccurate;numerical fits alone are not exact certificates. Subsequent producer lower-family exact-output report covers3/4..1 separately,not an independent assessment of those fits. Rescaled t=0 Gram/r->infinity endpoint alone is not unscaled functional/variational limit theorem. Prior eight-mode det(Hess psi)^2 heat-increase in PR307 obstructs a UNIVERSAL constant-diffusion proof method;it does not forbid a functional-specific heat/Stokes certificate with its own closed correction. Exact family construction/search/conditioning,finite rational algebra and analytic W2,4/scaling/general-U obligations remain separate costs. No overall discovery/practical advantage/Morrey separation;no missing proof fetch or producer interruption required.

evidence.quote: The important selection is scientific rather than cosmetic. Ultra retrieved an old original inequality and the audit withdrawing its false proof, then applied current compatible-field machinery to that actual target. The earlier certificate bounded a different cubic. The identity equating the two cubic integrals is false on explicit smooth fields, and the audit also supplies fields ruling out a finite multiplicative repair between those cubics. Neither failure refuted the original N901 target. The new code rebuilds the original cubic directly; it does not restore that identity or the failed unchanged general-U transfer.
